# dist

`toolchain-v4-ready` VM (jobwrap uid 1003, no sudo/unshare).

Contents: `routeb/gate4_runner.sh`, probe/verify/comparators, Ghidra export,
normalized C, fixture ELF + manifests + six-entry contract.

SHA-256 is in `m5-routeb-kit-2026-10-22-v3.zip.sha256`.
